top_issues: Online booking page is broken ('Restricted content')
No tel: link anywhere, so no click-to-call on mobile
Template placeholder text and mismatched service links undermine credibility

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt is a standard Yoast file allowing all crawlers. Hours, address and the multilingual/private-area differentiators are real text, and there is a WebPage/Organization JSON-LD graph (no LocalBusiness with hours). Booking is the failure point: /book-appointment shows a 'Restricted content' page, so neither a customer nor an agent can book online, and the phone is not clickable.

operations_signals.signal: Booking module is behind a 'restricted content' wall, so all appointments still flow through the phone line
Walk-ins welcome but appointments prioritized - front desk juggles a walk-in queue against the book with no self-serve scheduling
Seven-day operation with 10-8 hours five days a week means long phone-coverage windows for a small team

scores.reasons: Booking is broken and the site still carries template filler on a 400-review salon - large gap, small fixes; salon budget limits spend but the volume supports the value.

caveats: Ratings and review counts are third-party republications (Birdeye, medspastandard, spagrades) because Google Maps listings could not be opened directly in this session; treat them as approximate and re-check the live Google Business Profile before outreach.

It Aesthetix (7 NJ clinics) and Ivy Pediatrics (10 offices) are multi-site regional groups rather than single-location shops; they are included as operating but may fall outside a small-business target profile (inference).

Health-related businesses (pediatrics, med spas) carry HIPAA/medical-advertising constraints that make some automation work slower than the effort ratings suggest (inference, not verified against each business's policies).
No contact or booking form was submitted anywhere; booking flows were inspected only up to the point of data entry.
Phone screenshots were captured at 390x844; the K Aesthetics finding of a roughly four-second blank first paint is from one load on this connection and may vary.
data_gaps: Ivy Pediatrics: the live site returned '403 Unauthorized' to the headless browser, so no phone-width screenshot, JSON-LD check or visual layout review was possible; text content came from fetch only.
Google Business Profile claim status, hours completeness and photo counts could not be verified for any business (no Maps access without sign-in).
TKI The Kaga Institute: review counts differ by directory (29 on Birdeye); the practice's primary Google rating was not directly confirmed.
ReNova Skin Med Spa /appointments is password-protected, so it is unknown whether a real scheduler sits behind the wall or whether the page is simply unfinished.
John Martin Hair Co: could not confirm whether the Fresha profile actually accepts online bookings (no booking widget or calendar was visible in the fetched page or on the salon site).
Luna Hair Salon: no owned website was found after multiple searches; findings rely on Birdeye, BestProsInTown and Loc8NearMe listings, and the two directories disagree on rating (4.8 vs 4.3).
Batch data may be stale for Medical Aesthetics of NJ (site lists Suite E and phone 732-307-7762) and Impressions Salon (site lists Suite C and 732-613-1942).
